issues.where: GX.E0LM.e0_secondCountable_of_cauchy (l.2808-2813), its SORRY tag; REPORT.json sorries[1], findings_interface[1], questions[1]; module docstring SCOPE (O4)
issues.problem: The tag gives a misdiagnosed obstruction. It says the Reg M route 'needs the classical developing theorem for Reg M, not built for an arbitrary non-second-countable M'. At the current pin (lean-causal ca2ad78), the strict Causal.Flat.SecondCountable has two sorry-free results. Causal.Flat.flat_secondCountableTopology says every T2 connected (Isom 𝐌ⁿ, 𝐌ⁿ)-manifold is second countable, with no SC hypothesis; this is Geroch, flat case, DEC-49. Causal.secondCountableTopology_of_gx is the general version. Both go through GX.developing_theorem on the universal cover (GX/Structure/Developing.lean:454, which needs only LocPathConnected and semilocally simply connected) and through secondCountableTopology_of_isLocalHomeomorph. CAMPAIGN.md also states that the universal cover and the classical developing theorem 'are all built'. That module is importable here under DEC-33. So the half the dispatch prescribed ('Reg second countable by Causal.secondCountableTopology_of_isLocalHomeomorph') is available. What it needs is a bridge: Reg M as a ChartedSpace (Minkowski 2) with HasGroupoid (gxGroupoid (isom 2)), built from e0_exists_minkChart_M and e0_localUnique_reg, plus connectedness of Reg M (punctured E₀ balls are connected). The tag's other half is circular. It says 'countably many BTZ lines (each meets S once, which needs (O2))', but O2 (e0_globalBTZ, hLine) is stated under [SecondCountableTopology M], which is the conclusion of O4. So the genuine remaining gap is narrower than reported: passing from SC of Reg M to SC of M across sing₀, without SC of M. Reg M SC makes M ccc, but a Prüfer-type attachment of uncountably many lines is not excluded by that alone. The interface question 'should the CBG interface carry second countability of the glued M (or of Reg M)?' is mis-scoped as a result: Reg M's SC is derivable, so only the BTZ-line part could need an interface change.
issues.fix: Restate the SORRY tag and the REPORT entries with the precise remaining obstruction (SC across sing₀ without SC of M; O2 cannot be used because it assumes SC). Preferably prove SecondCountableTopology of Reg M (and of each component if connectedness is not proved) as a named lemma via Causal.Flat.flat_secondCountableTopology and the regular-chart bridge, and reduce e0_secondCountable_of_cauchy to the BTZ-line step. Narrow the interface question accordingly.

summary: The resumed file builds with exactly the 2 reported sorries (O2 line, O4 secondCountable_of_cauchy). Every other declaration is axiom-clean. Round 0's major is resolved. ModelMeasures is genuinely built: one global admissible pair, Lebesgue in regular ChartIso charts plus λ₁ on the BTZ line. timeFunction, curvesExtend and isCompact_* follow from SFA, so they are modulo O2 only. O1 is closed. typeAgreement is correctly shown false with a sorry-free counterexample, and the instance is honestly presented as conditional on that refutable field. The one touched label is correctly partial and unmarked, and it is hypothesis-free and stronger than the paper. The verdict is 'issues' because of one major. The O4 tag and REPORT say Reg M's second countability needs an unbuilt developing theorem. In fact the strict Causal.Flat.flat_secondCountableTopology (Geroch, flat, no SC) and GX.developing_theorem exist at this pin. The tag's fallback through O2 is circular, since O2 assumes SC of M. The real gap is only the passage across the BTZ lines, and the interface question should be narrowed to that. Minors: O2 is still unbuilt (a genuine library gap, though an order-theoretic route exists); stale lean-causal provenance (731ed99 vs the pinned ca2ad78); closed wrappers filed under §7 'open obligations'; and two carried style items.
